actions.action: Preview the edit’s resolved downstream effects
actions.mechanism: Resolve dependencies separately per brand and theme, then map changed values to actual rendered foreground/background pairs.
actions.implementation: Traverse reverse references through all alias levels. Show affected pairs with labeled current/proposed values, alias paths, and numeric contrast; flag cycles as unresolved.
actions.check: Test a multi-level alias, a cycle, and one token serving both roles; verify affected pairs and explicit cycle diagnostics.
actions.risk: Missing render contexts can hide affected pairs.

actions.action: Keep brand exceptions explicit and traceable
actions.mechanism: Treat brand overrides as protected resolution boundaries, retaining their provenance rather than flattening them into shared values.
actions.implementation: Show each override’s owner, source, and current/proposed resolved values. Require explicit approval for direct override changes; expose inherited alias effects separately.
actions.check: Edit a shared base: literal overrides remain unchanged, alias overrides expose downstream changes, and every exception retains its source path.
actions.risk: Preserved overrides may still produce illegible combinations.

actions.action: Gate publishing through an isolated review draft
actions.mechanism: Keep edits separate from published tokens until affected pairs have known results and required reviews are recorded.
actions.implementation: Use draft, evaluated, reviewed, and published states. List threshold failures, contrast regressions, and unresolved pairs with textual statuses; invalidate reviews after further edits.
actions.check: Attempt publishing before evaluation, with a cycle, and after changing a reviewed draft; each must block pending resolution or renewed review.
actions.risk: Color review does not establish complete accessibility.

actions.action: Offer local repairs instead of global reversions
actions.mechanism: Constrain repair suggestions to failing pair roles, avoiding unnecessary changes to shared bases or protected brand values.
actions.implementation: Generate candidate semantic-token adjustments; where one token’s text and background uses conflict, propose role-specific aliases. Preview values, contrast, and affected consumers before acceptance.
actions.check: For a dual-role token, verify each proposed repair against both roles and all affected pairs; reject newly failing combinations.
actions.risk: Role-specific aliases can increase token maintenance; contrast alone cannot judge visual quality.
